scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, tagline, value proposition, and call-to-action buttons correctly

steps.description: Navigate to the MirDB homepage URL
steps.context: User accesses the homepage for the first time

steps.description: Check that 'MirDB' product name and logo are prominently displayed
steps.context: Hero section should be immediately visible above the fold

steps.description: Confirm tagline 'A persistent key-value store with memcached protocol support' or similar is present
steps.context: Tagline should clearly communicate the product's unique value

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are visible and clickable
steps.context: Primary and secondary call-to-action buttons should be prominent

test_cases.expected: Hero section contains 'MirDB' text element
Tagline contains 'persistent key-value store' and 'memcached' keywords
Button scrolls to quick start section or navigates to getting started content
Button navigates to GitHub repository URL
Hero section exists with semantic HTML elements (h1, p, a/button)

scenarios.name: Features Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the features section showcases all four key features with appropriate content

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the features section of the homepage
steps.context: Features should be organized in a card-based layout

steps.description: Check for feature card highlighting memcached protocol compatibility
steps.context: Should emphasize ability to use existing memcached clients

steps.description: Check for feature card explaining data persistence via SSTables
steps.context: Should differentiate from standard memcached which loses data on restart

steps.description: Check for feature card describing LSM tree and compaction
steps.context: Should explain efficient write-heavy workload handling

steps.description: Check for feature card highlighting Rust language benefits
steps.context: Should emphasize memory safety and performance

test_cases.input: Count feature cards in features section
test_cases.expected: At least 4 feature cards are displayed
Content mentions 'memcached' and 'compatible' or 'protocol'
Content mentions 'persistent', 'SSTable', or 'survives restarts'
Content mentions 'LSM tree' or 'compaction'
Content mentions 'Rust', 'memory-safe', or 'performance'
Features section uses semantic markup with proper heading hierarchy
